name: Super Web Kittens
source:
Welcome to the new future where intelligent animals with anime eyes have inherited Earth from extinct humans and created a new society, based on the pets and their human owners relationship. After certain conflicts between pets, Cats have seized power and turned newly born world into a crazy dystopia, based on the caste system. However, despite everything, hope remains even in a such dark place. Everything changes when a young human arrives to the Capital High School, unique place, where boundaries between castes simply don't exist. Or maybe nothing changes at all.

But, remember, this game is NOT a cat dating simulator!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到一个全新的未来：人类灭绝后，长着动漫般大眼睛的智慧动物继承了地球，以宠物与人类主人的关系为基础，建立了新的社会。宠物之间经历了一些冲突后，猫族夺取了权力，将这个新生世界变成了以种姓制度为根基的疯狂反乌托邦。然而，即便如此，在这样黑暗的地方，希望依然尚存。一名年轻的人类来到首都高中时，一切都将改变。这是一所独特的学校，种姓之间的界限在这里根本不存在。又或许，什么都不会改变。

不过，请记住，这款游戏绝不是猫咪恋爱模拟器！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1058840/]Steam[/url]]
